Candidates broadly supported bringing back sidewalk vendors. Gutierrez and Bermudez proposed a committee or commission that included vendors; Hernandez called for residents, merchants, vendors, cultural groups and city departments to devise a plan; Torres and Brown proposed designated vending spaces. Fielder advocated for vendors’ voices and protection from criminalization.
